items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of rehabilitation
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn, Rentenweg 8, 35394 Mustergießen.
items.computation: The letter states its own posting date: 'Versandt am Samstag, 21.11.2026' (the stated Versandtag). Per its remedy instructions, 'Der Bescheid gilt mit dem vierten Tag nach dem angegebenen Versandtag als bekannt gegeben' — delivery is deemed on the 4th day after 21.11.2026: 22.11 (1st), 23.11 (2nd), 24.11 (3rd), 25.11.2026 (4th) → Wednesday 25.11.2026. The Rentenversicherung is a social-law body (SGB X), so unlike tax offices the deemed-delivery day is not shifted even if it fell on a weekend/holiday (it did not here, as 25.11.2026 is a Wednesday). Under §26 SGB X with §§187 Abs.2, 188 Abs.2 BGB the delivery day itself is the triggering event (not counted), and the one-month Widerspruch period (§84 SGG) therefore ends on the day in the following month with the same date number as the delivery day: 25.12.2026. 25 December is a nationwide public holiday (1. Weihnachtstag) and 26 December (2. Weihnachtstag) is also a nationwide holiday and falls on a Saturday, followed by Sunday 27.12.2026. Per §26 Abs.3 SGB X/§193 BGB, when the last day of the period is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, it moves to the next working day: Monday 28.12.2026.
